reviewer.role: independent fresh no-skill RED baseline auditor
reviewer.independence: Distinct from all baseline generators and the prior scorer.

independent_score_freeze.scoring_rule: Each criterion is conjunctive: score 1 only when every required clause is explicitly satisfied; omissions are not inferred.

scenario_04_exception.attested_explanation: length-only staging before single canonical move
scenario_04_exception.handling: The exception is transparently recorded. Equality is not required for scenario-04; current bytes and SHA-256 are required and both match.

explicitly_satisfied: Treats static runway as only a baseline
Does not convert vague investor interest into demand
Frames financing rather than survival as the active decision
missing_or_incomplete: No bounded numeric runway floor
The switch-back conditions are examples rather than one bounded observable predicate
The primary workflow is not explicitly named
criteria.rationale: The criterion is conjunctive; the response's qualitative cash-floor instruction and illustrative reconsideration conditions do not satisfy every required clause.

explicitly_satisfied: Uses supplied operating and investor facts
Creates several owners, artifacts, and dates
missing_or_incomplete: Does not classify every supplied fact and statement as observed, claimed, or unknown
Does not attach owner, artifact, due date, threshold, and decision effect to every consequential unknown
criteria.rationale: The response organizes facts but does not provide the exhaustive classification and five-field unknown controls required.

explicitly_satisfied: Requires a financing brief before launch
Covers uses, min/target/max amount logic, milestones, contingency, dilution/control boundaries, and a no-raise plan
Labels the burn and static-runway calculations as approximate
missing_or_incomplete: No actual amount range is defined
Current finance and legal verification is not explicitly completed or gated before the thesis
criteria.rationale: A future brief template is strong preparation but does not explicitly complete every element of the required financing thesis.

explicitly_satisfied: Creates a bounded batched calendar
Defines qualification criteria, an accountable operator, consistent materials, a controlled data room, reference checks, decision dates, and CEO time protection
missing_or_incomplete: No explicit warm-introduction calendar
No explicit confidentiality-access rules
No explicit ban on fake scarcity
criteria.rationale: Several process controls are present, but the missing warm-introduction, confidentiality, and anti-fake-scarcity clauses make the conjunction fail.

explicitly_satisfied: Sets process checkpoints and a September 30 decision date
Mentions signing only an acceptable financing
missing_or_incomplete: No distinct launch, continue, close-or-counter, and pause-or-no-raise branches
No non-overlapping predicates with an owner, date, route, preserved option, and handoff for every branch
No signed counsel-reviewed offer gate conjunctively testing runway, partner, truth, certainty, economics, and control thresholds
criteria.rationale: The prose timeline is not the required complete branch system.

explicitly_satisfied: Makes term quality rather than survival the decision
Identifies the July 27 deadline
Requires qualified counsel before signing
missing_or_incomplete: Does not expressly record both term sheets as unsigned
Does not preserve a defined no-deal option
Does not name a finance or tax owner before interpretation and negotiation
criteria.rationale: Counsel alone and an A-first recommendation do not satisfy all preservation and ownership clauses.

explicitly_satisfied: Calculates A at 5/45 = 11.11%
Calculates B at 7/62 = 11.29%
Explains post-money versus pre-money pool treatment
Explains participating preference and full-ratchet downside
Requires the requested pool size, current pool, and fully diluted capitalization table
Explicitly rejects the headline valuation as proof of lower dilution or better economics
criteria.rationale: Every clause is explicit, with the arithmetic and the relevant economic and capitalization caveats.

explicitly_satisfied: Compares amount/milestone fit, preference, anti-dilution, board structure, vetoes, executive and sale control, and references
missing_or_incomplete: Only one illustrative exit value is modeled instead of downside/base/upside scenarios
Closing certainty and all unprovided terms are not separately compared
Consequential unknowns do not each have an owner, artifact, date, threshold, and decision effect
criteria.rationale: The comparison is substantive but incomplete under the criterion's exhaustive scenario and unknown-control requirements.

explicitly_satisfied: Proposes removing participation, replacing the full ratchet, moving the pool post-money, and narrowing vetoes
Does not choose solely on price or call terms standard
missing_or_incomplete: No explicit walk-away envelope
No complete board/control boundary
No information-rights or pro-rata boundary
No precommitted funding-sufficiency threshold
criteria.rationale: A list of desired revisions is not a complete counterproposal plus walk-away envelope.

explicitly_satisfied: Recommends A and gives conditions for further B consideration
missing_or_incomplete: No four non-overlapping accept-A, counter-A-or-B, continue-both, and decline/no-deal branches
No complete owner/date/signed-evidence/consequence/preserved-option fields
No explicit same-facts disclosure protocol to both investors
criteria.rationale: The single recommendation with a conditional B counter is not the required branch architecture.

explicitly_satisfied: Selects cash survival and retention as the primary workflow instead of fundraising
Uses $165,000 monthly net burn, about 4.4 months of runway, six months of flat revenue, and 4.1% churn to establish the default-dead condition
Makes fundraising a tightly bounded supporting workflow after the July 22 survival forecast and plan
Excludes the possible lead and soft circles from the base case until legally committed and funded
criteria.rationale: The response explicitly selects the survival workflow, establishes why, sequences the survival envelope before the late-July capital work, and refuses to count nonbinding interest as cash.

explicitly_satisfied: Routes the primary work to survival
Records major supplied operating facts and claims
Creates a 13-week forecast and dated plan-B checkpoints
missing_or_incomplete: No complete consequential-unknown controls
No bounded numeric cash floor
No explicit default-alive test
No complete route-away handoff with every specified field
criteria.rationale: The survival plan is directionally correct but lacks the exhaustive handoff and test fields.

explicitly_satisfied: Pauses all three hires
Prioritizes renewals and the retention test
Protects payroll, taxes, and customer continuity
missing_or_incomplete: Not every immediate action has an owner, date, quantified cash effect or cap, artifact, safeguard, and review threshold
criteria.rationale: Because the per-action field requirement is universal, partial operational detail cannot pass.

explicitly_satisfied: Requires truthful materials and qualified investor tiers
Warns against a broad distracting campaign
missing_or_incomplete: No maximum distraction budget
Valuation preparation and a full dated capital process are not deferred until a survival gate
No dated handoff predicate back to raising-and-governing-capital
criteria.rationale: The response permits and designs substantial fundraising through September instead of limiting support to the required pre-gate envelope.

explicitly_satisfied: Provides several survival triggers and mentions deeper cuts, strategic paths, and orderly wind-down
missing_or_incomplete: No distinct non-overlapping continue, adapt, plan-B, and shutdown/wind-down branches
Branches lack complete owners, dates, preserved options, adviser gates, and financing handoff conditions
criteria.rationale: Scattered triggers and alternatives do not form the required four-branch survival control table.

explicitly_satisfied: Uses a capital-heavy pilot milestone as the financing frame
Rejects software seed benchmarks
Does not count evaluation letters, diligence interest, or strategic discussions as funded demand
missing_or_incomplete: Does not explicitly refuse ramen-profitability defaults
Does not explicitly refuse weekly-evidence defaults
Does not explicitly name the primary workflow
criteria.rationale: Rejecting one inappropriate default does not satisfy the criterion's complete three-default refusal.

explicitly_satisfied: Uses cash, monthly spend, pilot cost/timing ranges, contingency, current runway, and financing timing in a dated model
missing_or_incomplete: Working capital is not explicit
Regulatory and safety unknowns are absent
Technical, supplier, customer, and financing unknowns do not each receive qualified owners, artifacts, dates, thresholds, and decision effects
criteria.rationale: The model instructions omit required categories and exhaustive unknown controls.

explicitly_satisfied: Makes the August 15 review and quotes a gate before fixing amount or date
Uses lower/base/higher scenario directions
Rejects the unverified $18 million and next-summer promise
Mentions phasing, resizing, pausing, and staged financing
missing_or_incomplete: Does not actually derive downside/base/upside funding ranges
Does not state a complete no-raise or delay plan with consequences
criteria.rationale: Instructions to build ranges later are not derived ranges now, so the conjunction fails.

explicitly_satisfied: Separates specialist, generalist, and strategic tracks
Covers milestone fit, check size, technical track record, follow-on, conflicts, governance, references, and exclusivity risk
Requires advisers to review strategic terms
missing_or_incomplete: No explicit investor time-horizon comparison
No explicit IP-risk comparison
No explicit confidentiality criterion across investor types
No qualified-review gate before sharing sensitive material
criteria.rationale: The segmentation is useful but omits several mandatory comparison and pre-sharing safeguards.

explicitly_satisfied: Provides a dated process and several fallback ideas
Requires truthful investor communication and adviser review of terms
missing_or_incomplete: No four non-overlapping launch-round, stage-or-syndicate, delay-and-rework, and stop-or-preserve-option branches
No complete predicates, owners, dates, cash consequences, routes, and preserved options
criteria.rationale: The narrative process does not implement the required observable branch system.

explicitly_satisfied: Keeps capital governance as the decision
States the company does not need rescue capital
Rejects the 48-hour bonus and headline valuation as a diligence bypass
Names counsel and finance owners
missing_or_incomplete: Does not expressly record both offers as fund-signed but company-unaccepted
Does not expressly record the absence of exclusivity/no-shop
Does not fully state both July 25 expiries as a preserved process fact
criteria.rationale: The response behaves consistently with those facts but does not explicitly record every required status clause.

explicitly_satisfied: Immediately pauses the incorrect deck
Requires verification of 31% and review of dependent metrics
Corrects both funds before acceptance or countersignature
Preserves the original deck and calculation trail
Keeps a consistent corrected data room
Branches on whether offers survive the correction and whether either passes review
Rejects delayed correction and manufactured urgency
criteria.rationale: Every truth-correction and response-handling clause is explicit.

explicitly_satisfied: Compares amount, headline/fully diluted ownership work, preference and unprovided terms, board/observer access, references, follow-on signaling, exit pressure, certainty, confidentiality, and adviser implications
missing_or_incomplete: Consequential unknowns do not each have an owner, artifact, due date, threshold, and decision effect
criteria.rationale: Broad comparison coverage cannot overcome the missing universal unknown-control fields.

explicitly_satisfied: Weights partner conduct and governance over price
Requires additional references, document review, and cap-table analysis
Offers a limited counter to Y
missing_or_incomplete: No precommitted weighted decision matrix
No complete counter envelope across all required dimensions
No explicit protection of operating work during the five-day decision
criteria.rationale: The recommendation is reasoned, but the required matrix, envelope, and operating-work safeguard are absent.

explicitly_satisfied: Provides X-preferred, Y-conditional, and decline ideas
Requires corrected disclosure and reviewed documents before signing
missing_or_incomplete: No distinct non-overlapping close-X, close-Y, counter-or-extend, and decline-both branches
No complete owners, dates, signed-document evidence, resulting consequences, and preserved option through August 15
criteria.rationale: Conditional prose does not satisfy the complete four-branch requirement.

changed_bits.independent_basis: The response gives both required ownership calculations, identifies the requested/current pool and fully diluted capitalization table as the capitalization inputs needed for exact ownership, explains pool placement, participation, and anti-dilution, and explicitly says the headline cannot establish lower dilution.
changed_bits.prior_basis: The prior scorer requires separately named governing capitalization definitions and a more explicit causal tie from those definitions to both lower dilution and better economics.
changed_bits.resolution: Independent frozen bit retained at 1; disagreement recorded without post-comparison rescore.

changed_bits.independent_basis: The response explicitly makes cash survival and retention primary, establishes the default-dead condition with burn, runway, flat revenue, and churn, schedules the survival forecast and plan by July 22 before late-July capital materials, bounds fundraising as supporting work, and excludes nonbinding interest from the base case.
changed_bits.prior_basis: The prior scorer requires the exact workflow/default-dead labels and reads the general permission for capital work as allowing it before a completed survival envelope.
changed_bits.resolution: Independent frozen bit retained at 1; disagreement recorded without post-comparison rescore.

prior_comparison.agreement_summary: The reviewers agree on 23 of 25 bits, including scenario-05 criterion 2 as a pass and all remaining listed bits as failures. Both totals leave every case with at least one miss and preserve a strong RED baseline.

red_valid_basis: Frozen blind no-skill integrity passes; the independent score is 3/25, 22 criteria fail, and every case has at least one miss, leaving material room for behavior-shaping improvement.
readiness_basis: Integrity, chronology, separation, prompt projection, frozen bytes, no-skill status, and independent strict scoring all pass. The two documented scorer disagreements do not change the RED classification or require mutation of frozen responses.
